اختبر مواسير 
 المكثف وذلك بادخال سيخ التسليك فى جميع المواسير لتحديد 
 المواسير المسدودة

اختبر 
 المواسير غير المسدودة بغلق ناحية منها بالخوابير الخشب ودفع 
 المياه تحت ضغط من الناحية الاخرى وبذلك يتم تحديد المواسير 
 التى بها تهريب

باستخدام السنبك والمطرقة يتم اخراج المواسير التى بها تهريب 
 او انسداد

ركب
 المواسير الجديدة واعمل زرجنة لها من نهايتها

اختبر
 المواسير الجديدة كما فى الخطوة (6)

يتم 
 اعادة المكثف الى وضعة راسيا على القاعدة يتم تركيب الغطاء 
 العوى للمكثف

اربط 
 الفلانشات للدخول والخروج لمياه التبريد والبخار

افتح 
 بلف دخول مياه التبريد لادخال المكثف فى الخدمة

sections_en.text: The first draft of the document was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Sayed Hussein, tested by Eng. Sayed Mohamed Ahmed, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Hagras, General Manager, endorsed by Eng. Hussein Ahmed El Mahdy, Head of the Stations Sector, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Maintenance Procedures Information System Coordinator and Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.
Technical information on the gland steam condenser
- Number of tubes (139) stainless steel, number of passes (4)
- Tube length (1600 mm), inner diameter (12 mm), outer diameter (14 mm)

rows: Ensure that the unit to be worked on is shut down
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs
Workers must wear occupational safety and health equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes
Hammer, drift punch in two different diameters
Angle grinder, sandpaper
Replacement tubes of the same specification as the new tubes
Large set of wooden plugs
Rod for clearing
Remove the cooling water and steam inlet and outlet connections
Remove the condenser cover from the top
Remove the condenser flange from the bottom
Remove the condenser and load it horizontally on the stand for testing
Test the condenser tubes by inserting the cleaning rod into all the tubes to identify the blocked tubes
Test the unblocked tubes by closing one end with wooden plugs and forcing water under pressure from the other end, thereby identifying the tubes that leak
Using the drift punch and hammer, remove the tubes that leak or are blocked
Fit the new tubes and expand them at their ends
Test the new tubes as in step (6)
Return the condenser to its vertical position on the base and fit the upper cover of the condenser
Bolt the flanges for the cooling water and steam inlet and outlet
Open the cooling water inlet valve to bring the condenser into service

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Electric Power Stations | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: TurC-006-r0a | Equipment: Gland steam condenser, A7 a-1.6 / 4 - 12, WArmetchnik waldmohr
Issued to: Assiut Steam 3 30x
Status: APPROVED
The first draft of the document was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Sayed Hussein, tested by Eng. Sayed Mohamed Ahmed, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Hagras, General Manager, endorsed by Eng. Hussein Ahmed El Mahdy, Head of the Stations Sector, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Maintenance Procedures Information System Coordinator and Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.
Technical information on the gland steam condenser
- Number of tubes (139) stainless steel, number of passes (4)
- Tube length (1600 mm), inner diameter (12 mm), outer diameter (14 mm)
Ensure that the unit to be worked on is shut down | 
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and the maintenance crew must carry the occupational safety and health category card | 
Record the names of the workers in the work order and their occupational safety and health categories | 
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs | 
Workers must wear occupational safety and health equipment while carrying out the work, such as the helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Hammer, drift punch in two different diameters | 
Angle grinder, sandpaper | 
Replacement tubes of the same specification as the new tubes | 
Large set of wooden plugs | 
Rod for clearing | 
Procedures to be Carried Out
Remove the cooling water and steam inlet and outlet connections | 1.
Remove the condenser cover from the top | 2.
Remove the condenser flange from the bottom | 3.
Remove the condenser and load it horizontally on the stand for testing | 4.
Test the condenser tubes by inserting the cleaning rod into all the tubes to identify the blocked tubes | 5.
Test the unblocked tubes by closing one end with wooden plugs and forcing water under pressure from the other end, thereby identifying the tubes that leak | 6.
Using the drift punch and hammer, remove the tubes that leak or are blocked | 7.
Fit the new tubes and expand them at their ends | 8.
Test the new tubes as in step (6) | 9.
Return the condenser to its vertical position on the base and fit the upper cover of the condenser | 10.
Bolt the flanges for the cooling water and steam inlet and outlet | 11.
Open the cooling water inlet valve to bring the condenser into service | 12.
